data.title: Taiwan Prosecutors Detain Nvidia Staffer In China AI Chip Smuggling Probe
data.description: Earlier this year, the U.S. Justice Department arrested the co-founder of AI server maker Super Micro for allegedly smuggling Nvidia’s advanced AI chips to China.
data.author: Siladitya Ray
data.keywords: Nvidia,Taiwan,Super Micro,Nvidia Chip smuggling,China AI,Chip export controls
